comparison.objective: Clean a fibre end face and insert the connector; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled wipe followed by contamination-free connector insertion versus rotary adjustment with a hex key and dynamic validation.
comparison.success_condition: At least 4 cm one-stroke clean, no intervening contact, and fully seated connector versus quantified stopping and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Although both require precise tool/part contact, their objectives and physical mechanisms differ.
